units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 15:6">Targ. O. Deut. XV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:12">ib. XXVIII, 12</cite> <he>תְזִיף</he> (some ed. <he>תְזוּף</he>); Y.
Targ. II Kings IV, 1 (ed. Lag. מוֹזִיף Af.).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a:3">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כי יְזִיף וכ׳</he> if this man shall borrow money of thee.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 20a:20">Kidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא נֵיזִיף וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>נוֹזִיף</he>, v. infra) rather than borrow on interest.
<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:15">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה י׳ ופרע</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) borrowed and paid off (made up by night for neglect of study by day).
<cite ref="Taanit 12b">Taan. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>לֵיזוֹף מר וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לוֹזִיף</he>) borrow and pay back (postpone your fast for another day); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 15:2">Targ. Y. Deut. XV, 2</cite> <he>דְּיִזּוֹף ב־</he>.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן דיזיף שבתא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לשב׳</he>, Buxt. <he>דיוֹזִיף</he>) him who lends to the Sabbath (incurring an additional expense in honoring the Sabbath), the Sabbath will repay; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16">Yalk. Gen. 16</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 356">Yalk. Is. 356</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 37:21">Targ. Ps. XXXVII, 21</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 32b:8">B. Bath. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>הדרת אוֹזַפְתִּינְהוּ מינאי</he> (Rashb. <he>הדר יזפתינהו</he>, Ms. M. <he>שקלתינהו</he>) thou hast borrowed it again of me.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:6">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דאו׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>דיזיף</he>) if one borrowed &c.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:26">Lam. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>אוֹזְפִיתוּן</he>, v. <cite ref="H00235"><he>חוֹבָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> beg. <he>דיוֹזִיף וכ׳</he> some ed. he who borrows on interests.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 15:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>אוֹזָפָא תּוֹזְפִינֵּיה</he> (Y. <he>מוּזְפָא תּוּז׳</he>). Ib. XXVIII, 12; a. e.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 19:17">Targ. Prov. XIX, 17</cite> <he>נְיוֹזִיף</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="N00458"><he>נְזִיף</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 8b">Bekh. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>גברא דאו׳ וטרף דהדר מוֹזִיף …</he> he who once lent money and had to resort to seizing (v. <cite ref="I00860"><he>טְרַף</he> I</cite>), why does he lend again?; a. e.
